risks.title: Commodity and energy cost volatility
risks.summary: AB InBev is highly dependent on the availability and pricing of raw materials (barley, hops, aluminum), energy, and water. Inflationary pressures, geopolitical instability (Russia-Ukraine, Middle East), and tariffs create production cost volatility that is difficult to fully pass through to selling prices without losing competitiveness.
risks.score_rationale: Major risk mentioned in the executive summary (p.1) with strong language ('could have an adverse effect'). Directly impacts gross margin and pricing competitiveness. Trend stable but exacerbated by geopolitics. High category weight for beverage sector.

risks.title: Reliance on independent distributors and retail consolidation
risks.summary: AB InBev relies on independent distributors and wholesalers for retail sales. Increasing consolidation of retail chains (supermarkets, e-commerce) strengthens customer bargaining power and reduces margins. Risk of losing key distributors or failing to acquire stakes in strategic distribution networks.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited in risk summary (p.1) as a key business risk. Moderate language but acknowledges structural vulnerability. Trend up: retail consolidation accelerating. Critical category weight for brewery distribution model.

risks.title: Changing consumer preferences and product demand
risks.summary: Consumer preferences are shifting toward non-alcoholic, low-calorie, and alternative beverages (hard seltzers, RTD cocktails, energy drinks). AB InBev must rapidly innovate in 'Beyond Beer' to maintain market share. Failure to anticipate or adapt its portfolio could erode sales of legacy brands (Budweiser, Corona).
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements (p.iii) and risk summary. Moderate language ('changes in consumer preferences'). Trend up: shift toward non-alcohol, low-alcohol, and alternatives. Very high category weight for brewery facing market disruption.

risks.title: Increased competition and industry consolidation
risks.summary: AB InBev faces intense competition from regional brewers, premium craft brands, and new entrants (cannabis, functional beverages). Regulatory or deregulatory policies may favor or hinder consolidation. Risk of market share loss to more agile competitors or those better positioned in growing segments.
risks.score_rationale: Cited in forward-looking statements (p.iii): 'effects of competition and consolidation'. Moderate language but acknowledges structural competitive pressure. Trend stable but geopolitical context may accelerate M&A. Critical category weight for global leader.

risks.title: Brand reputation and image damage
risks.summary: Flagship brands (Budweiser, Corona, Stella Artois) are exposed to reputation risks related to alcohol consumption, health scandals, or environmental and social practices. Anti-alcohol awareness campaigns, advertising regulations, or quality incidents could damage brand image and reduce demand.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed in risk summary (p.1): 'Damage to our reputation or the image and reputation of our brands'. Direct and strong language. Trend up: increased sensitivity to ESG, alcohol, and public health issues. High category weight for iconic brand portfolio.

risks.title: Government regulation and alcohol beverage taxation
risks.summary: AB InBev operates in a highly regulated environment: alcohol excise taxes, advertising restrictions, labeling standards, and environmental regulations (plastic, water). Higher taxes or advertising restrictions would reduce demand and margins. Regulatory variations across countries complicate global strategy.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements (p.iii): 'changes in applicable laws, regulations and taxes'. Moderate language but structural risk. Trend up: excise taxes, advertising restrictions, and environmental standards are tightening. Very high category weight for highly regulated alcohol sector.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and personal data loss risks
risks.summary: AB InBev manages customer data, production operations, and critical logistics systems. Cyberattacks, ransomware, or data theft could disrupt production, compromise supply chains, or expose personal data. Potential remediation costs and reputational damage.
risks.score_rationale: Cited in forward-looking statements (p.iv): 'technological disruptions, threats to cybersecurity and the risk of loss or misuse of personal data'. Dedicated Item 16K on cybersecurity. Moderate language. Trend up: increasingly sophisticated attacks, supply chain risks. Growing category weight for digitized company.

risks.title: Acquisition integration and restructuring risks
risks.summary: AB InBev has completed major acquisitions (SABMiller 2016, Budweiser APAC). Risks include operational integration challenges, unrealized synergies, loss of key talent, or higher-than-expected restructuring costs. Integration failures could destroy shareholder value.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements (p.iv): 'risk of unexpected consequences resulting from acquisitions, joint ventures...and our ability to successfully...integrate'. Moderate language. Trend stable but AB InBev historically active in M&A (SAB 2016, Budweiser APAC). Moderate category weight but high potential impact.
